lastCompletedStory.title: Extract sendKeysVerified with composer-emptied verify + bounded retry

nextStoryContext: US-002 added `sendKeysVerified` (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) as the new pane-push path: PRE-send idle-gate (reuses isOrchPaneIdle, extracted into a private waitForIdlePane helper), atomic text+Enter send-keys WITHOUT -l, POST-send `isComposerEmptied` STATE-only verify (checks the pushed text left the tail of a fresh capture-pane; never parses report content), bounded retry (default maxAttempts=3) with backoff via the reused `computeBackoffMs` (src/supervisor/loop.ts:606) fed LOCAL base/max constants (300ms/2000ms) scoped to this fast UI-retry context (NOT the supervisor's 60s/300s no-progress constants). On exhaustion it calls an injected `logEvent?: (kind: WorkerEventKind, detail: WorkerEventDetail) => void` with `('push-undelivered', { paneId, retriesExhausted: maxAttempts })`; omitting logEvent is a zero-side-effect no-op (mirrors the merge-watch sub-state-machine logEvent seam pattern, NOT the full WorkerEventLogger event-object shape used elsewhere). `sendKeysWhenIdle` now delegates straight through to `sendKeysVerified`, so review.ts/issue.ts/spec.ts (all constructed via `SendKeysWhenIdleOptions`, a subset of `SendKeysVerifiedOptions`) get verify+retry for free with zero call-site changes -- none of them wire up `logEvent` yet, so in production today a delivery failure from those three callers is silently swallowed (no event recorded) until a future story threads a real logEvent through. US-003 (per prd.json notes on US-002/handoff continuity, not yet read by this agent) is expected to be the story that wires the sidecar's report pusher to call sendKeysVerified with a REAL logEvent (writing to .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl via makeFileEventLogger), producing the first actual 'push-undelivered' events end-to-end -- check prd.json for the exact next story id/title rather than assuming. Exported new symbols from dispatch.ts: `sendKeysVerified`, `SendKeysVerifiedOptions`, `isComposerEmptied` (all consumed directly by test/dispatch.test.ts). File-size ceilings raised: src/tmux/dispatch.ts 205->329, test/dispatch.test.ts 244->345 (staged _ref note already committed). No new external lib touched.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript refactor/extraction inside the existing tmux dispatch module (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) plus its Bun test suite; no external library API surface exercised beyond the already-used bun:test and node:child_process types.
